title: Returns, exchanges and voids
description: Find the sale by its receipt number, or pick one of the latest sales.

errors.generic: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

issues.INVALID_INPUT: The information entered is not valid.
issues.PERMISSION_DENIED: You are not allowed to do this.
issues.APPROVAL_INVALID: The manager's approval is invalid or has expired. Enter the PIN again.
issues.SHIFT_NOT_OPEN: The shift is not open. Open your shift first.
issues.SALE_NOT_COMPLETED: This sale was voided, so it cannot be returned.
issues.TOO_MANY_LINES: Too many lines selected for one return.
issues.UNKNOWN_LINE: The selected line is not part of this sale.
issues.INVALID_QUANTITY: The quantity is not valid. Pieces must be whole numbers.
issues.ALREADY_REFUNDED: This item has already been fully returned.
issues.OVER_REFUND: You cannot return more than what is left. Reload the sale.
issues.REASON_NOTE_REQUIRED: A note is required when the reason is “Other”.
issues.NOT_SUPPORTED: Part of this sale (gift card, store credit) cannot be returned yet.
issues.REFUND_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: The refund cannot be paid out this way. Card and QPay can only be refunded up to what they paid.
issues.PAYMENT_MISMATCH: The payout amounts do not add up to the refund total.
issues.CASH_NOT_IN_UNITS: Cash is refunded in multiples of the smallest coin.
issues.ALLOCATION_FAILED: The refund could not be allocated to the original payments. Ask a manager for help.
issues.REFUND_WINDOW_EXCEEDED: The return window has passed, so a manager's approval is needed.
issues.EXCHANGE_INVALID: The replacement items are not valid.
issues.EXCHANGE_MISMATCH: The replacement sale total does not match.
issues.TOTAL_MISMATCH: The refund amount has changed. Reload the sale and check it.
issues.PAYMENT_PROVIDER_FAILED: The payment provider did not accept the refund. Please try again.
issues.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This refund number was already used with different contents. Reload the sale.
issues.CONCURRENT_DUPLICATE: This refund is being processed right now. Wait a moment and check again.
issues.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Please try again.
issues.ALREADY_VOIDED: This sale has already been voided.
issues.SALE_IN_OTHER_SHIFT: The sale was made in another shift and cannot be voided. Make a return instead.
